Thomas D. Westergaard is a Danish designer and founder of Ceremoni Studio, where he transforms the traditional candle into a kinetic sculpture. Instead of treating wax as a static object, he engineers candles that bend, twist, and weave together as they burn. Every prototype is tested through long time-lapse recordings to study the flame, the melting wax, and the structure, refining each design until movement and combustion become one. His work sits somewhere between industrial design, engineering, and performance. #art #artist #avantgarde #candles #timelapse

Weather moves. Humans move. Design moves. Good design moves you. Our new kinetic sculpture is shaped from foam, acrylic, ash wood, and plywood. Cut acrylic forms a camshaft that drives movement. Changing a static structure into something that is in motion. Connecting with the movement of the earth, humanity, and ourselves has the power to move us. No one else can feel it for you, only you can let it in. We’re interested in the space between art, engineering, the natural world, and what happens when you give an object the ability to move. This piece is part of an ongoing exploration of kinetic sculpture and our belief that good design is an experience.  ☁️ More to come ☁️ Open for commissions ☁️ See what we’re making next @recdepartment  #kineticsculpture #fabrication
